title: Corporate banking portal, organization roles and approval chains
workflow: Verify company KYB and authorized signatories
Configure roles, limits and scoped accounts with independent approval
Prepare a payment or file batch and validate beneficiaries and totals
Require configured multi-person authorization before submission
Submit unique payment instruction IDs and track each external outcome
Reconcile approved batch totals with executed ledger and statements
invariants: Organization beneficial ownership does not automatically confer account signing authority
Self-approval disallowed for restricted corporate payments
User roles cannot expand beyond signed organizational mandates
Batch approvals are bound to an immutable file digest and amount totals
Individual unknown external outcomes remain unresolved independently
Corporate admin cannot cross into another legal entity without verified grant
No corporate interface writes authoritative balances
acceptance_tests: Modified file after approval invalidates signatures
One failed payment does not falsely mark whole batch settled
independent_gate: Verified KYB/mandate evidence, institutional corporate product limits and executed maker-checker/financial tests.
